name: Rice Kramer Peanut Mix
ingredients_raw: Rice Crackers: 55% (Rice, Starch, Soy Sauce (Water, Soy bean, Wheat, Edible Common Salt), Cane Sugar, Maltodextrin (Corn), Dehydrated Vegetable Powder (Garlic, Onion), Iodized Salt, Spices and Herbs (Chilli, Parsley), Thickening Agent (INS 1451), Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631), Black Salt, Acidity Regulator (INS 330), Permitted Natural Colours (INS 150a, INS 160c), Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substance and Yeast Extract) and Peanuts: 45% (Roasted Peanuts, Spice Mix, Sunflower Oil).
